'''Henrik Schneider''' (also written '''Hendrick Scheider''') was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 66 in the Sullust region, from Budapest, Hungary.<ref name="decsq-sullust" /><ref name="smlist" />

He lived in Pecs and studied civil engineering at the Technical University of Budapest. He played from the game's 1995 arrival in Hungary and joined the Red Squadron in 1997. He translated the rules and every card into Hungarian, and wrote about the game for Hungarian card and role-playing magazines. In 1999 Decipher invited him into its Flight Leader Group.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
